rule: Every performance-validation test requires actual execution of its relevant workload on the approved Zen 5 benchmark host (AMD Ryzen 7 9700X). Without complete evidence matching the candidate, workload and configuration, performance validation is incomplete; hosted, simulated and static evidence is diagnostic.

routes.main-compare: 9700x-direct-bench.yml job compare (every commit that lands on main, against its first parent or the nearest measured first-parent ancestor, #2752)
routes.pull-compare: 9700x-direct-bench.yml job compare-pull (benchmarks/9700x/compiler-compare.request; compiler-compare-v1, throughput-corpus-v2, scaling-v1 or exact clang-analyze-full-v1 opt-in, #2769)
